item.title: Alderman proposes holding parents liable for teen criminal actions
item.description: On Tuesday, Ald. Ray Lopez (15th Ward) introduced a new ordinance in the Public Safety Committee that could hold parents liable for the criminal actions of their children.

item.title: Mom creates foundation to support families with limb differences
item.description: Ali Barnum created the Limb Difference Collective Foundation, a community of support for families with children born with limb differences, after her son was born without a hand.

item.title: Stolen van recovered on North Side; dogs inside safe
item.description: A van with eight dogs inside was stolen from an Animal Lovers Pet Salon in Lincoln Park, Chicago on Tuesday morning.

item.title: DHS Sec. Noem's lack of knowledge on Chicago shootings raises eyebrows
item.description: Department of Homeland Security Sec. Kristi Noem gave surprising testimony on Tuesday, claiming she did not know basic details about shootings involving federal immigration agents in Chicago over the last few months.

item.title: City leaders assemble for groundbreaking of Chicago Fire FC's new stadium in The 78
item.description: Chicago Fire FC and city officials held a groundbreaking ceremony for the team's new stadium at the South Loop site known as 'The 78', with the project set to cost $750 million and feature an open-air, riverfront design, with the team beginning to host games during the 2028-29 MLS season.
